name: 公示送達に電子画面での閲覧を追加
summary: 区税と後期高齢者医療に関する公示送達は、現在、書面を掲示して行う仕組みです。この議案で、公示事項を不特定多数が閲覧できる状態にする措置を加え、区の事務所にある電子計算機の画面で閲覧できる方法も設けます。
changes: 公示事項を不特定多数が閲覧できる状態にする措置を加える
公示送達の方法に区の事務所にある電子計算機画面での閲覧を加える
who: 区税の公示送達の対象となる人
後期高齢者医療の公示送達の対象となる人
why: 地方税法等の一部改正に伴い、公示送達に関する規定などを整備するためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Adds electronic-screen viewing to service by public notice
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Bunkyo City Special Ward Tax Ordinance and the Bunkyo City Ordinance on Medical Care for Older Senior Citizens
en.summary: Service by public notice for city taxes and medical care for older senior citizens is currently carried out by posting written notices. This bill adds a measure to make the matters being announced available for viewing by an unspecified number of people. It also provides a method for viewing them on a computer screen at a ward office.
changes: Adds a measure to make the matters being announced available for viewing by an unspecified number of people
Adds viewing on a computer screen at a ward office as a method of service by public notice
who: People subject to service by public notice for city taxes
People subject to service by public notice for medical care for older senior citizens
en.why: The ward says this is to update provisions on service by public notice and related matters following partial amendments to the Local Tax Act and other laws.
